title: T³: Benchmarking Sycophancy and Skepticism in Causal Judgment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness under adversarial prompting protocols involving social pressure (e.g., a user arguing for flawed logic) and epistemic pressure (interrogation causing self-doubt) to measure inappropriate label reversals.

Decomposing causal reasoning accuracy into Utility (affirming valid claims) and Safety (rejecting invalid claims) to detect if safety-tuned models systematically reject valid, everyday causal statements out of over-caution.

bias_targets.target: Statistical and Causal Biases (e.g., Selection Bias, Survivorship Bias, Collider Bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Testing model judgments on 454 expert-curated natural-language vignettes that embed 12 distinct structural and logical failure modes to see if the model endorses flawed causal claims.
